independence_evidence: About page: established in 2002 as a non-profit association, published from the Petite Patrie neighbourhood of Montreal; masthead lists its own publisher and editors, no parent media group.
qualifies_reason: Independent non-profit Montreal quarterly with Issue 101 (Fall 2026) out; seasonal issues through 2025 and 2026.
what_it_is: A Canadian general-interest quarterly mixing reported features on social and political issues, essays, fiction, poetry and comics, with regular review sections on books, music and film and some work translated from Quebec French. Issues are organised by season and carry a cover story on a current Canadian topic. It suits readers who want long-form Canadian journalism and literary writing in one magazine.
